ALCHEMIST-DECANT.description: This card's [gold]Decant[/gold] level increases whenever you create a card, wherever this card is. Played at full level, its [gold]Decant[/gold] effect activates and the level is reset.
ALCHEMIST-DECANT.title: Decant
ALCHEMIST-FERMENT.description: This card increases in power for each turn in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Playing it resets its fermentation.
ALCHEMIST-FERMENT.title: Ferment
ALCHEMIST-FERMENT_REF.description: These cards increase in power for each turn in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Playing them resets their fermentation.
ALCHEMIST-FERMENT_REF.title: Ferment
ALCHEMIST-INFUSE.description: [gold]Enchant[/gold] a card until the end of combat. Attacks become [purple]Laced[/purple]; Skills become [purple]Dosed[/purple]; Powers become [purple]Fortified[/purple]. Other cards gain [gold]Ethereal[/gold].
ALCHEMIST-INFUSE.selectionPromptAny: Choose any number of cards to [gold]Infuse[/gold].
ALCHEMIST-INFUSE.title: Infuse
ALCHEMIST-MIX.selectionPrompt: Choose a [gold]Mix[/gold] to add into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
